headline: The Wall Street Journal says the share prices of memory-chip makers may give clues about how long the AI boom will last.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1 because only the headline could be checked.
importance_line: People watching the AI boom could look to memory-chip stocks for a clue about how long it lasts, but the headline promises clues, not a verdict on when the boom ends.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports on how memory-chip stocks may show how long the AI boom will last.
notes: WSJ paywalled (HTTP 401); no other outlet carried the story. Google News showed other memory-stock pieces (Seeking Alpha, Stocktwits, Motley Fool) that are not the same story and were not used. Headline only.
